messages:
miguel_partnerships: Quick kickoff: APAC SouthWest region going live with CloudScale (marketplace) + LatticeSI integration. Need capacity quota, marketplace SKU mapping, KMS onboarding, and a joint announcement window. Target: two-week runway. Anyone can chase approvals?

sara_cloud: I'll own marketplace SKU mapping. Need list of SKUs and expected RPS.

miguel_partnerships: TL;DR: expected steady 20 RPS, 99th latency 250ms, peak burst 80 RPS during demos. SKUs: prefer fractional A100 offerings or equivalent. I'll DM details (topology + perf profile).

kofi_infra: For quotas, partner needs to file quota request with CloudScale. I can file but need SR template + expected vCPU/GPU counts. Also need region-specific subnet ranges for private deployment.

devin_sales: I'll coordinate partner comms and the joint announcement timeline. We should avoid public press until legal signs off. Propose soft-launch to pilot customers first.

tanya_legal: @miguel_partnerships please add data residency doc we require. Also need customer data flow diagram and DPA acceptance from LatticeSI. Legal can do expedited review if received by Thu.

ops-bot: quota-request-created: Q-99827 by kofi_infra for APAC-SW GPUs. Link: https://internal.ops/quotas/Q-99827

lattice_si_rep: Thanks team. We'll provide service topology and DPA draft by tomorrow. For KMS we prefer bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via CloudScale KMS. Any objections?

sara_cloud: BYOK ok, but marketplace onboarding requires KMS integration test. Add `kms-test` to the onboarding checklist.

kofi_infra: Noted. I'll provision a test VPC and a pair of A100 instances for validation. ETA: 48 hours after quota approval.

miguel_partnerships: Can someone own the marketplace paperwork? Need pricing tier, metering plan, and promotional SKUs (pilot discount).

devin_sales: I can own pricing + promo; will sync with finance for metering rules. Need SKU mapping from @sara_cloud by EOD.

tanya_legal: flagged: export controls for certain models. @miguel_partnerships list the models planned to publish in marketplace so we can run checks.

eng-bot: deploy-checklist: marketplace-tests, kms-integration, billing-metering, legal-dpa, quota-approved

miguel_partnerships: OK thanks. Action items: @sara_cloud SKU mapping + tests, @kofi_infra quota filing & test VPC, @tanya_legal DPA + export check, @devin_sales pricing/promo. Weekly sync Friday 10am PT? :calendar: 

sara_cloud: Friday 10am PT works. Will post a short checklist in this thread with SKUs.

kofi_infra: filing SR now.

lattice_si_rep: We'll have DPA draft and topology by EOD tomorrow. Happy to join Friday sync.

devin_sales: adding to calendar, sharing meeting invite.

miguel_partnerships: thanks all. Will update thread if timeline shifts. :thumbsup:
